title: 10 Best Ononis Spinosa Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Ononis spinosa are teas, decoctions, mucillages, tinctures, and poultices, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas made from the dried herb are commonly used to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. Decoctions, which involve boiling the roots, are valued for their stronger potency in treating respiratory and skin conditions. Mucillages, derived from the plant’s fibers, are used as a natural demulcent to ease irritation in the throat and stomach. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb, often used for its antiseptic and astringent properties, while poultices applied topically help with wounds and inflammatory conditions.
